title: Filipino Tomatoes Wrap
description: A delicious and filling breakfast wrap made with juicy tomatoes, crispy pork, and crunchy vegetables, all wrapped in a steamed leaf.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and sauté until the onion is translucent.
Add the pork loin and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the canned tomatoes and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, steam a large leaf until crispy.
Assemble the wrap by placing the pork and tomato mixture onto the leaf.
Add your choice of vegetables, such as lettuce or spinach.
Fold the leaf to enclose the filling and serve.
